32123-F.s: This bill formally adopts the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) at EUR 8.7 million, expressed in thousands of euros, with effect from 1 January 2010. It is a routine budget appropriation with no delegation of rule-making or new executive powers.
q: Whereas, under Article 105 of the Constitution, the budget of expenditure and revenue of the State must be established by law.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat ingevolge artikel 105 van de Grondwet de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het Rijk bij de wet moet worden vastgesteld

32222-F.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) by adjusting its expenditure and revenue figures in line with the autumn supplementary budget (Najaarsnota). The amendment takes effect from 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget statement of the Animal Health Fund for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32360-C.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget schedule of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) by setting the commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants, and by specifying the entry into force of the act. The explanatory memorandum is a short technical note explaining a small positive variance caused by differences between estimated and final distribution criteria.
32360-C.j: The memorandum justifies the variance by explaining that the grant payments can differ from the budget until the distribution factor is finalised, without invoking any new powers.
q: The reason for the difference is that, as long as the distribution factor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to municipalities can deviate from what is stated in the budget.

De reden van het verschil ligt in het feit dat zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de gemeenten kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat.

32500-G.s: The bill formally establishes the budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds (VAT compensation fund) for 2011 at EUR 2,844,200 thousand in both expenditure and revenue. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force rules.
q: The budget statement of the VAT compensation fund for the year 2011 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het BTW-compensatie fonds voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

32710-D.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the Fonds economische structuurversterking (FES), changing expenditure and revenue lines, and sets the amounts in thousands of euros. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The need has emerged for an amendment to the budget statement of the Fonds economische structuurversterking for the year 2010.
De noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Fonds economische structuurversterking voor het jaar 2010.

33090-B.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting revised commitment amounts for general, additional, integration and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It also adjusts the expenditure and revenue tables in the attached supplementary budget statement, effective from 1 December 2011.
33090-B.j: The memorandum justifies the grants by describing decentralisation payments for experiments and programmes, not by any delegation or new executive powers.
q: The experiment to promote labour participation of single parents aims to make part-time work financially attractive for single parents subject to the duty to seek work.
Het experiment bevordering arbeidsparticipatie alleenstaande ouders heeft als doel werken in deeltijd financieel aantrekkelijk te maken voor sollicitatieplichtige alleenstaande ouders.

33280-A.s: The bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for 2012, adjusting expenditure and revenue lines across transport, waterways and megaprojects. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force from 1 June 2012, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
33280-A.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by delays in road adjustment, the Raad van State interim ruling on A1 Gooi, and unused rail risk reserves carried over from 2011.
q: The Road Adjustment Decision (WAB) has been delayed because of the Council of State's interim ruling on the A1 'Gooi.
Het Wegaanpassingsbesluit (WAB) is vertraagd vanwege de tussenuitspraak van de Raad van State bij A1 ’t Gooi

33640-A.s: The bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for 2013, adjusting obligations, expenditure and revenue lines for road, rail, regional, waterway and mega-project items. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force from 1 June 2013, with retroactive effect where publication is late.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2013
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2013

34000-J.s: The bill formally adopts the 2015 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Deltafonds, setting expenditure and revenue at €1,374.6 million in thousands of euros, effective 1 January 2015. The explanatory memorandum covers allocations including experimentation under article III of the Deltawet and the Marker Wadden project.
q: The budget statement of the Deltafonds for the year 2015 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34200-H.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statement of the BES Fund (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba) through a closing budget law (Slotwet), with expenditure and revenue adjustments in thousands of euros. It sets the budget in thousands of euros, takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We have considered that the need has emerged for an amendment to the budget statement of the BES Fund (H) for the year 2014
Wij ... hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van BES fonds (H) voor het jaar 2014

34350-B.s: The bill amends the 2015 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting revised commitment amounts for general, additional, integration and decentralisation grants and adjusting expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 December 2015, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget of expenditure and receipts of the municipal fund for the year 2015 is amended, as shown in the budget statement attached to this law.
De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

34550-XVII.s: This bill formally establishes the 2017 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, setting appropriations in thousands of euros across policy articles. The attached explanatory extract describes the budget's policy targets, programme spending and planned policy evaluations, rather than delegating rule-making power.
q: The budget statement for the year 2017 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34620-B.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting revised expenditure and revenue figures and fixing the 2016 commitment amounts for general, additional, integration and decentralisation grants. It takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the budget statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

34730-XVII.s: The bill amends the 2017 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), adjusting spending and commitment figures in line with the Voorjaarsnota, with a reduction of EUR 10 million on article 1. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides that the amendment takes effect on 1 June 2017 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), set by the act of 21 December 2016
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII), vastgesteld bij de wet van 21 december 2016

34775-XVI.s: This bill sets the 2018 departmental budget for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, including expenditure and revenue figures by policy article. It also fixes the 2018 budget statements for the three executive agencies under the ministry.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2018 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

35000-I.s: This bill adopts the 2019 budget statute (begrotingsstaat) for the Crown (Koning), setting appropriations of €43.252 million for constitutional allowances to royal family members and the King's functional expenditures. It contains no new delegations of rule-making power or shifts of power to the executive.
q: Article 1 The budget statute attached to this law for the year 2019 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35350-A.s: The bill amends the departmental budget statement of the infrastructure fund (Infrastructuurfonds) for 2019 through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, waterway and mega-project items. It sets budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective retroactively from 1 December 2019.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided, together with the States General ... The departmental budget statement of the infrastructure fund for the year 2019 is amended.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd.

35450-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, changing expenditure and commitment amounts across policy articles, with effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 1 May 2020. It is a budgetary adjustment that reallocates funds, including for extra customs controls on international sanctions policy.
35450-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by funding extra customs controls on sanctions policy and implementing a parliamentary amendment, without any delegation of power.
q: The expenditure budget for article 1.2 has been reduced for 2020. This is mainly due to a contribution to carrying out extra checks on international sanctions policy at customs.
Het uitgavenbudget op artikel 1.2 is voor 2020 verlaagd. Dit komt hoofdzakelijk door een bijdrage aan de uitvoering van extra controles ten aanzien van internationaal sanctiebeleid bij de douane.

35925-XIX.s: This bill adopts the 2022 budget statement for the National Growth Fund (Nationaal Groeifonds), setting expenditure of about 7.38 billion euros across knowledge development, R&D and innovation, and infrastructure, plus administration costs. The explanatory memorandum says the fund will later be converted into a budget fund by a separate establishment law, and that reallocations between articles and transfers to other budgets will go through supplementary budgets submitted to parliament.
35925-XIX.j: The memorandum justifies flexible allocation across projects and a 100% year-end margin by letting the fund's committee choose a balanced multi-year package, while safeguarding budget authority through supplementary budgets.
q: Deviating allocations across the articles and contributions to the budgets of receiving departments are submitted to parliament through a supplementary budget, to safeguard budgetary authority.

Afwijkende verdelingen over de artikelen en bijdragen aan de begrotingen van ontvangende departementen worden via een suppletoire begroting voorgelegd aan het parlement, ter borging van het budgetrecht.
d: budget expenditure entries in departmental budgets or budget funds
p: The fund's independent committee and ministers may reallocate across articles and transfer amounts to other budgets, with reallocations later submitted to parliament through supplementary budgets, which preserves budget authority.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft 2022 budget bill for the National Growth Fund (Nationaal Groeifonds) and found no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport accompanies the opinion and proposes some amendments to several budgets, referring to annexes.

36250-A.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Mobility Fund (Mobiliteitsfonds) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, waterway and mega-project articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2022.
36250-A.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by project delays (A27, ViA15, A16 Rotterdam) with funds shifted to 2023 so that multi-year budgets remain unchanged.
q: The balance will be added to the relevant article components in 2023, so that the size of the budgets remains unchanged over multiple years.
Het saldo wordt in 2023 aan de betreffende artikelonderdelen toegevoegd, zodat de omvang van de budgetten meerjarig ongewijzigd blijft.

36350-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (first supplementary budget), changing commitments, expenditure and revenue across five policy articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective retroactively from 1 June 2023.
q: The departmental budget statement of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36410-C.s: The bill fixes the 2024 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) at €3,340,648 thousand and sets the commitment amounts for the general and integration/decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It enters into force on 1 January 2024, or retroactively from that date if published later.
36410-C.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the bill by reference to parliamentary motions asking the government to examine emergency funds and co-signature of decentralisation laws, without itself granting new executive powers.
q: The commitment amount under Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is set at €3,283,650,000 for the 2024 grant year.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2024 vastgesteld op € 3.283.650.000.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an opinion on the draft 2024 budget act for the Provinciefonds (provincial fund), finding no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The accompanying government reply (nader rapport) of 18 September 2023 was submitted with the advice, but since the Afdeling raised no points, there are no concerns to answer.

36600-B.s: This bill fixes the 2025 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) and sets the 2025 commitment amounts for the general grant, supplementary grants, integration grants and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It enters into force on 1 January 2025, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
36600-B.j: The memorandum justifies the budget figures by reference to the CPB baseline and coalition agreement adjustments, without any new delegation of powers.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and supplementary grants is set at €40,147,299,000 for the 2025 grant year.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2025 vastgesteld op € 40.147.299.000.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State states it has no remarks on the draft budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) for 2025 and advises submission to the House. The government's reply confirms this blank advice and notes technical adjustments: updated accres figures from the Miljoenennota 2025 and preliminary room under the BTW compensation fund ceiling for 2024, raising the total to € 44.896 billion.

36600-XXII.s: The bill sets the 2025 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the ministry of Housing and Spatial Planning and the budget statements for its executive agencies, including the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the Dienst van de Huurcommissie, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes housing policy plans, including regional steering powers and procedural acceleration, but the bill itself delegates no rule-making power and shifts no power from checks to the executive.

36800-XVII.s: This is the 2026 budget bill (Begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), setting total expenditure and revenue figures by policy article. The explanatory memorandum describes spending priorities, EU Delegated Cooperation, export control, sanctions enforcement and budget cuts to education and civil society programmes.
q: In 2026 the Netherlands intends to apply this instrument increasingly, also within Global Gateway, so that more EU money can be spent through Dutch parties.
In 2026 wil Nederland dit instrument in toenemende mate toepassen, ook in het kader van Global Gateway, zodat meer EU-geld via Nederlandse partijen besteed kan worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued a blanket opinion on the 2026 budget bill for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport accompanies the opinion, noting that some budgets require amendments set out in annexes, but does not respond to specific objections.
